title: work_bash RTK availability mismatch was hard to reconcile
wanted_capability: When project guidance requires shell commands to be prefixed with `rtk`, sandbox-native shell surfaces should make the effective PATH, HOME, command wrapper, and session/tool environment visible enough to reconcile a reported `rtk` failure with later direct validation that `rtk` is available.
missing_primitive: work_bash command-environment provenance for PATH/tooling mismatches
fallback_used: Added shell_path and tool_resolution to sandbox_status/sandbox_grounding so probes can see bounded PATH entries and command resolution for rtk, rg, git, cargo, and rustc without ad hoc shell forensics.
evidence: work_bash stderr: [rtk: No such file or directory (os error 2)]
direct dev MCP work_bash validation after retro: command -v rtk => /Users/invidious/.cargo/bin/rtk; rtk --version => rtk 0.40.0
notes: Counter-evidence shows current dev work_bash resolves rtk with HOME=/Users/invidious and PATH including ~/.cargo/bin, including inside nested bash -lc. Addressed as an observability/reconciliation gap by exposing process_env_visible_to_shell.PATH, shell_path, and tool_resolution; tiny live probe confirmed rtk true at /Users/invidious/.cargo/bin/rtk and rg false/null.
